version_note: Final reorganization under four mega-sections (Sense / Think / Act / Adapt). Hierarchy renamed in CSV form: Class → Action → Subaction → Instance. Unclassified holding-pen from v4.1 is dissolved; entries absorbed into mainline categories. Each row includes the human reviewer(s) attributed to its evidence. [PlanB] Retrieval restructured: the placeholder sub-category "Retrieve" is dissolved; the 5 main retrieve actions become first-class sub-categories. n_sub_categories: 42 → 46. | 2026-05 dropped 4-class super-layer; now 3-level: action→sub→leaf, aligned with arXiv:2605.13625v1
